discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-20, during the TC-020 build (GUI lane)
note: Reached from ftr-entry with product type 26B (Inv: Mutual Funds), transaction type 100 (Investment), a Security Class id and a Business Partner. Structurally unrelated to ftr-deal-irate.json (SAPLFTR_IRATE, the term-loan screen) - a completely different program, the modern 'Trading Transaction Manager' framework (SAPLTTM_UI_FRAMEWORK), with its own Check button (F6, tbar[1]/btn[6], not F8) and 8 tabs (Structure, Administr., Other Flows, Payment Details, Cash Flow, Memos, Partner Assignment, Status). Same program and field layout the web lane found independently (ftr-26b-deal.json in web-tests/screens/) - confirms this is a lane-independent screen, not a WebGUI rendering quirk.

transactionNumber.label: Transaction
transactionNumber.note: Header subscreen, present on every tab. Reads the literal placeholder '\INTERN\' before Save - the real, server-assigned deal number is only knowable from SAP's own confirmation message after Save, never from this field alone (it stays '\INTERN\' on this screen even after a successful save, since the screen navigates back to FTR_ENTRY on commit).

securitiesAccount.label: Securities Account
securitiesAccount.note: Defaults to '1000' already - the only Securities Account this client has (confirmed by the web lane's F4: exactly one row).

generalValuationClass.label: General Valuation Class

entries.90: Valuation area 2: Transfer posting mid-term -> short-term
entries.91: Valuation area 2: Transfer posting long-term -> mid-term

generalValuationClass.note: Not defaulted - starts blank ( key ' '). 'Short Term' is key '5' (not '1' 'Short-term investments' - a different, similarly-named entry). Select by key, not by typing text.

price.label: Price (Unit-Quoted)
price.note: Defaults to '0'. Required to be a real value.

positionValueDate.label: Position Value Date
positionValueDate.note: Defaults to today automatically - never set by this case, only read (to derive calculationDate/paymentDate, which are NOT auto-defaulted).

calculationDate.label: Calculation Date
calculationDate.note: Not defaulted - starts blank. Set to the same value read off positionValueDate.

paymentDate.label: Payment Date
paymentDate.note: Not defaulted - starts blank. Set to the same value read off positionValueDate.

paymentCurrency.label: Payment Amount currency
paymentCurrency.note: Defaults to INR for this profile. Asserted, never set.

checkButton.label: Check (F6)
checkButton.note: Validates only. A clean-except-for-payment-details check reports message class FTR0, number 030, type W ('No payment details entered for transaction') - a WARNING, but Save alone does not commit past it (see saveButton).

saveButton.label: Save (Ctrl+S)
saveButton.note: THE WRITE - but a bare Save press does not commit past the payment-details warning. Confirmed live 2026-08-20: pressing Save straight after Check reproduces message FTR0 030 unchanged and the Transaction field still reads the placeholder. The sequence that actually commits is Enter, Save, Enter - the second Enter is what produces SAP's own confirmation ('Financial transaction saved under number <n>', message T1 033) and navigates the screen back to FTR_ENTRY. Same finding as the web lane, confirming this is a backend/business-logic behavior, not a rendering-path quirk.
